summary: Add a local, explicit test mode so development is not blocked by the owner-approved runtime ceilings. PDH_DEV=1 or .local/app/DEV_MODE switches the gateway to a separate ledger (.local/app/usage-dev.jsonl) with separate loose ceilings; runtime ceilings and the runtime ledger are untouched. Adds a UI test-mode banner, CLI --dev, documented on/off steps and ceiling messages that name actual usage.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit d4739a3. Gateway/CLI/UI/docs; verification used the dev ledger, so the runtime ledger is unchanged.

budget_impact.rationale: The approved runtime ceilings and prices are unchanged and the runtime ledger did not grow. Dev spend is recorded separately and is explicitly test-only.
budget_impact.before: Testing consumed the approved daily budget and hit the 55,000-token ceiling.
budget_impact.after: Testing uses a separate ledger with its own ceilings; runtime budget untouched.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: dev_mode true; a call refused by the runtime ceiling succeeded; runtime ledger unchanged at 38 entries, dev ledger +1

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; budget tooling only, not recommendation quality

open_risks: The dev marker currently exists on this machine; it must be removed before any release or budget verification.
Dev ceilings are loose, so a runaway loop during testing is bounded only by them.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
